sections.description: Display Australian tourism products from the ATDW API with server-side transient caching and stale-while-revalidate fallback. Ensures visitors always see listings even when the ATDW API is temporarily unavailable.
sections.changelog:
2.1.1 — 2026-03-05

  • Added JezPress license management with admin gating
  • Admin pages (Dashboard, Settings, Logs) show license gate when inactive
  • Frontend shortcodes disabled when license is inactive
  • License page accessible regardless of license status

2.0.0 — 2026-03-05

  • Added server-side transient caching (configurable TTL, default 4 hours)
  • Added stale-while-revalidate fallback — serves cached data when API returns 502/500 errors
  • Added Purge ATDW Cache button on Dashboard page
  • Added JezPress auto-update support

1.3.1

  • Original release by Cenemil (client-side only, no server caching)
